name: burrow
description: Homelab management from your phone: persistent SSH terminals, files, container logs and AI analysis.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @burrow/shared && npm run build -w @burrow/server && npm run build -w @burrow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @burrow/shared && npm run typecheck -w @burrow/server && npm run typecheck -w @burrow/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @burrow/shared && npm run test -w @burrow/server && npm run test -w @burrow/web
